archetypes.name: dyn-panel-retry-carryforward
archetypes.rationale: New degraded-retry carry-forward path mutates panel-slot launch accounting; subtle drop/double-count risks
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the new _degraded_retry_carry_forward helper and its wiring in dispatch_panel in python/review_pipeline.py. Confirm carry-forward only skips re-launch for slots that are collector STATUS=OK AND whose output file is still present, and that every other slot (NOT_SUBSTANTIVE, missing-file, or unknown) is re-launched. Verify the path is gated strictly on degraded-retry.flag so the first pass always launches the full panel, and that the full manifest (not the reduced relaunch manifest) is still used for STATIC_SLOT_COUNT, threshold, coverage, and PANEL_MANIFEST consumers. Check the post-waterfall merge does not double-count outputs or misalign the outputs/tools index used to split EXTERNAL_OUTPUT_FILES vs CLAUDE_OUTPUT_FILES. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
